scope: Broaden the open-source DXF producer and consumer audit by examining GDAL's declared projection/writer boundaries and QGIS's independent ASCII AC1018 exporter. Refine peer admission without changing implementation behavior or support claims.

method.kind: Public primary-source documentation and source audit
method.sourceFreshness: QGIS master source is mutable and not pinned to a release binary. GDAL KNOWN_ISSUES.md has a June 2018 footer; treat listed limitations as documented risk/exclusion leads until rechecked on an exact current build. Stable GDAL driver documentation is also version-gated and must be paired with the runtime version/options at use time.
method.evidenceBoundary: Project documentation/source establishes route behavior and declared gaps, not a current execution against libdxfrw artifacts. No local defect, full-file parity, or support promotion was established.

evidence.topic: GDAL DXF projection and declared gaps
observed: The DXF driver maps DXF into OGR features and supports a bounded Create route; it is not a native CAD document model.

KNOWN_ISSUES.md lists unsupported MESH, MPOLYGON, RAY, TABLE, TOLERANCE and XLINE readers; missing 3D/OCS support for DIMENSION, LEADER and MULTILEADER; absent HATCH pattern interpretation and MLINESTYLE fidelity; WIPEOUT image omission; and ATTRIB writer omission for POINT BlockAttributes.
The same known-issues page warns that 3DFACE polygon/PEN representation is handled poorly, and its footer is dated June 2018.
doesNotEstablish: that every listed issue persists in a current GDAL release
a libdxfrw defect or a usable negative control without reproducing the case
CAD graph, ATTRIB sequence, 3D/OCS, or solid-semantic acceptance
evidence.planUse: Treat the list as a route-exclusion and recheck checklist. Only credit the exact feature/version/direction that a pinned current build freshly exercises; retain diagnostics and independently inspect its output.

evidence.topic: QGIS as an optional independent AC1018 ASCII DXF producer
observed: The current source emits ASCII DXF with $ACADVER AC1018.
The group-point writer emits Z when the point is 3D and force2d is false; the API exposes a force-2D option and a 3D polyline flag.
The route is GIS-layer export with map extent, CRS, unit, symbology, label, and optional block processing, rather than general CAD-document round-trip.
The visible QGIS tests include exporter execution and QGIS re-open checks, which are same-application checks rather than independent acceptance of libdxfrw output.
doesNotEstablish: a pinned current release behavior or independent run against this library
binary DXF, DWG, arbitrary tables/objects, opaque preservation, or ACIS semantics
untransformed coordinates unless the test explicitly fixes CRS and export options
evidence.planUse: Optionally use an already-available QGIS build at the composed checkpoint for a small source-authored AC1018 point/3D-line producer control. Inspect literal output tags independently and record exact build/options. Do not install it for per-slice tests or add it as a required dependency.

implementationReadiness.optionalProducerSelection: At most one additional common-geometry producer run at the composed checkpoint. Prefer an already-installed GDAL route; use QGIS only if the AC1018 3D-coordinate producer question warrants it. No per-slice peer run.
nextActions: Continue local implementation using generated fast tests and existing slice owners.
At the composed checkpoint, select a single already-available producer only when it answers a stated version/feature question.
Pin exact runtime/build, fix CRS and projection options, inspect source-authored expected tags, and record losses/warnings.
Keep GDAL and QGIS output as bounded producer evidence, not general CAD-document or 3D-semantic oracles.
